free_tier.stated: no service and no account; a patch to the Linux kernel WireGuard module with Ubuntu 24.04 binaries

egress.terms: not applicable; the software states no volume; ingress: tcp

tooling: Ubuntu 24.04 amd64 and arm64 archives, or build from source
chaining: composes only with hosts where the operator controls the kernel, so a free-tier VM works and a managed tunnel does not.
binding_note: both peers must run the patched kernel module, which means two hosts with module build or install rights; that is outside the vocabulary
reliability_note: out-of-tree kernel patch for a specific kernel and distro; both peers must match
confidence_note: a measured A/B against UDP WireGuard on a named path would raise it; the repository publishes its own comparison numbers, which are reported rather than reproduced here

evidence.proved: "adds a high-performance TCP transport patch to the Linux WireGuard kernel module" and the wg / wg-quick compatibility claim
"It has not been approved, endorsed, or adopted by the WireGuard project"
no GitHub releases, last push 2026-08-04, 27 stars
the author reports 512 comparison cells and CPU reductions of 6.7-10.9 percent for clean-LAN bulk transfer; reported, not measured here

notes: The only project that removes the extra hop instead of adding one: TCP framing happens in the kernel module, so there is no proxy process and no userspace re-encapsulation. It still needs a peer at the other end running the same patched module, so it does not reach a hosted tunnel, and installing a patched kernel module on both ends is a heavier commitment than running a userspace wrapper. Its measured numbers are the author's, quoted here as reported.

extras.wg_detail: "Keep the usual keys, peers, AllowedIPs, preshared keys, keepalives, wg, and wg-quick workflow" - the standard configuration drives it, with the transport swapped underneath
extras.volume_stated: not applicable; the software states no volume
extras.transit_note: directly between the two patched peers, with no intermediary process
extras.hosting_requirement: two hosts that can install the patched kernel module, one of them publicly reachable
